title: 光纖黏著固定與熱漂移
titleEn: Fiber adhesive attachment and thermal drift
summary: 以光纖膠固化收縮、熱失配與長期黏彈漂移為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Fiber-adhesive cure shrinkage, thermal mismatch and viscoelastic drift, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

steps.title: 選擇黏著位置：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Choose adhesive placement: model and design
steps.objective: 建立選擇黏著位置的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for choose adhesive placement.
steps.instruction: 先標出「選擇黏著位置」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。光路內膠需評估吸收與折射率，機械固定膠則仍會透過應力影響光路。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for choose adhesive placement. In-path adhesive needs absorption/index evaluation; out-of-path adhesive still affects optics through stress. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 分開光學窗口與固定支點，標示每處膠的功能。
steps.observationEn: Separate optical windows and mechanical anchor points and label each adhesive role.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「膠不在光路內就完全不影響光學」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Out-of-path adhesive cannot affect optical behavior" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交選擇黏著位置的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：分開光學窗口與固定支點，標示每處膠的功能。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for choose adhesive placement: Separate optical windows and mechanical anchor points and label each adhesive role. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.title: 機制與模型
knowledge.text: 光路內膠需評估吸收與折射率，機械固定膠則仍會透過應力影響光路。
knowledge.textEn: In-path adhesive needs absorption/index evaluation; out-of-path adhesive still affects optics through stress.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 分開光學窗口與固定支點，標示每處膠的功能。 不可推成：膠不在光路內就完全不影響光學
knowledge.textEn: Separate optical windows and mechanical anchor points and label each adhesive role. Do not infer: Out-of-path adhesive cannot affect optical behavior

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設兩條自由路徑的 Δα=15 ppm/K、長度 L=4 mm、ΔT=60 K，自由伸長差 Δu=3.6 μm。若此差全部投影成相同 Gaussian 模態 w=3 μm 的橫向位移，損耗 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB；實際黏著結構需另解約束和位移方向，不能把 6.25 dB 當實測值。 體積收縮率不是線性收縮率；小且各向同性時線收縮約為體積收縮的三分之一，但受約束膠層不能直接套用自由收縮位移。
knowledge.textEn: For free paths with Δα=15 ppm/K, L=4 mm and ΔT=60 K, mismatch is 3.6 μm. If entirely projected laterally onto matched Gaussian modes with w=3 μm, loss is 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB. Real constraints and displacement direction require separate analysis; 6.25 dB is not measured performance. Volumetric shrinkage is not linear shrinkage; small isotropic free linear shrinkage is about one third of volume shrinkage, but constrained bond lines require a mechanical model.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 用立方體三方向縮短推導體積近似，再指出膠層約束。 不可推成：1% 體積收縮就是每軸 1% 收縮
knowledge.textEn: Derive the volume approximation from three cube dimensions, then identify bond constraints. Do not infer: One-percent volume shrinkage means one percent on every axis

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設兩條自由路徑的 Δα=15 ppm/K、長度 L=4 mm、ΔT=60 K，自由伸長差 Δu=3.6 μm。若此差全部投影成相同 Gaussian 模態 w=3 μm 的橫向位移，損耗 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB；實際黏著結構需另解約束和位移方向，不能把 6.25 dB 當實測值。 體積收縮率不是線性收縮率；小且各向同性時線收縮約為體積收縮的三分之一，但受約束膠層不能直接套用自由收縮位移。
knowledge.textEn: For free paths with Δα=15 ppm/K, L=4 mm and ΔT=60 K, mismatch is 3.6 μm. If entirely projected laterally onto matched Gaussian modes with w=3 μm, loss is 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB. Real constraints and displacement direction require separate analysis; 6.25 dB is not measured performance. Volumetric shrinkage is not linear shrinkage; small isotropic free linear shrinkage is about one third of volume shrinkage, but constrained bond lines require a mechanical model.

steps.titleEn: Separate volume and linear shrinkage: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 用區分體積與線收縮的量測證據區分競爭解釋。
steps.objectiveEn: Use measurements of separate volume and linear shrinkage to distinguish competing explanations.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，執行下列資料判讀：用立方體三方向縮短推導體積近似，再指出膠層約束。 將原始量、單位、量測參考面與重複性分欄記錄；比較預測與觀察，說明能排除「1% 體積收縮就是每軸 1% 收縮」的直接證據，再決定接受、重測或修模。 假設兩條自由路徑的 Δα=15 ppm/K、長度 L=4 mm、ΔT=60 K，自由伸長差 Δu=3.6 μm。若此差全部投影成相同 Gaussian 模態 w=3 μm 的橫向位移，損耗 4.343(3.6/3)²=6.25 dB；實際黏著結構需另解約束和位移方向，不能把 6.25 dB 當實測值。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and perform this data review: Derive the volume approximation from three cube dimensions, then identify bond constraints. Record raw values, units, reference planes and repeatability separately. Real constraints and displacement direction require separate analysis; 6.25 dB is not measured performance.
